unlock_prose: Sign in with a password, or with the key the house printed when it started.
unlock_prose_signin: Sign in with the name and password you were given.
wayin_signin_prose: Everyone in the household signs in here, and so does whoever runs the house. What you see next depends on whose account it is.
wayin_name_hint: Whoever runs the house leaves this empty.
wayin_not_recognised_lead: That name and password were not recognised.
wayin_not_recognised_prose: Try them again. This page is not told which of the two was not recognised, and it is not told which accounts exist.
wayin_declined_lead: The house would not let you in.
unlock_refused_lead: The house stopped taking what this page was signed in with.
unlock_refused_prose: A key works until the house starts again, and a sign-in until it runs out or its password changes. Sign in again, or use the key the house printed when it last started.
unlock_hint: It is a long word of letters and numbers. The house prints it when it starts, on the line that says where to reach it.
door_stranded: Answering, with no address to hand out
door_none: Nothing is published to the house
door_unrecognised: Standing in a way this page has no word for
door_derived: Worked out from what your stack runs.
door_named: You chose {door}, and this is it.
door_refused: You chose {named}, and this stack will not send anybody there. {because}
door_chosen_unrecognised: How this came to be the door is not something this page has a word for.
door_reaches_here: It answers from where you are.
door_reaches_not_here: It does not answer from where you are.
door_reaches_unknown: Nothing here can tell whether it answers from where you are.
door_reaches_unrecognised: Whether it answers from where you are is not something this page has a word for.
facing_shelf: One kind of thing, reached from the library
facing_operators: An index over every program, the ones the house should never see among them
facing_unstated: Published to the house, and nothing says what it is to them
facing_unrecognised: Something this page has no word for
unlock_signed_out_prose: The house stopped taking this sign-in. Sign in again to carry on.
pairing_prose: Make a fresh pairing code for the companion app: a line the phone reads or you type, naming where it reaches this machine and the certificate it will be shown. It carries no password, and the phone still signs in with yours. lemonfiber makes it only while the web interface is served encrypted on your network.
pairing_written: Scan the code with the phone, or type or paste this line:
pairing_compare: Before the phone trusts this machine, check it shows:
